verdict.rationale: three.js is an open-source client-side library (MIT) that ships as source you clone/npm-install and embed directly in your own page via import maps or bundlers, requiring no vendor-hosted service — evidenced by the git clone instructions, import-map usage pattern, and renderer setup code running entirely in-browser. Missing for 10: an explicit self-hosting/deployment guide or Docker-style packaging (not needed since it's inherently a bundled library, but not documented as such).
